texts:
We are an OpenAI Select Partner, and the 2026 program year has brought a dedicated API organization and a ChatGPT workspace with Codex credits, valid for the full program year.

The workspace and credits fund testing the free 3D Studio connector in ChatGPT, customer proofs of concept, and live demos of 3D agents. The connector is live now and answers with 15 tools, no key and no account. three.ws/openai

altText: A reel of three.ws/openai on the live product: the Select Partner badge and "3D, natively, inside ChatGPT," then "Live. 15 tools answered in 196 ms, no key and no account" with the mcp-studio URL, then generation tools forged free, text_to_avatar, and mesh_forge listed as free.

The only nit is that the verified 300,000 credit figure would make the already strong first line sharper; the post ships as is.
